brief:
Iranian Deputy Foreign Minister Kazem Gharibabadi said Iran does not seek war but will respond firmly to any attack, Shehab Wire reported. He warned that American and Israeli aggression could widen in scope if the international community fails to stop it.

Gharibabadi's remarks reflected Tehran's stated position of defensive readiness amid regional tensions and repeated threats of military strikes against Iranian targets.

title: Iran will firmly retaliate any aggression, deputy foreign minister says
